description: This file is a Makefile defining device configurations for a build system related to openwrt. It specifies device-specific parameters, images, supported devices, and related properties for multiple hardware devices.

methods.name: Device/buffalo_whr-g301n
methods.description: Defines configuration parameters for the Buffalo WHR-G301N device, including SOC, model, product name, image size, supported devices, and default settings.

methods.name: Device/dlink_dir-615-e4
methods.description: Defines configuration parameters for the D-Link DIR-615 E4 device, including SOC, vendor, model, variant, image sizes, supported devices, and build steps for images.

methods.name: Device/engenius_eap350-v1
methods.description: Defines configuration parameters for the EnGenius EAP350 v1 device, including SOC, vendor, model, variant, image size, loader flash offset, and associated image name.

methods.name: Device/engenius_ecb350-v1
methods.description: Defines configuration parameters for the EnGenius ECB350 v1 device, similar to the EAP350 with specific board parameters.

methods.name: Device/engenius_enh202-v1
methods.description: Defines configuration parameters for the EnGenius ENH202 v1 device, including packages, image size, loader offset, and device name.

methods.name: Device/pqi_air-pen
methods.description: Defines configuration parameters for the PQI Air-Pen device, including SOC, vendor, model, packages, image size, supported devices, and default setting.
